ai_summary: Aastha Spintex Limited reported no deviation or variation in the utilization of its INR 170 Crore IPO proceeds for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, with INR 168.96 Crore deployed as intended. The majority of funds were utilized for the acquisition and working capital requirements of Falcon Yarns Private Limited. A minor unutilized balance of INR 1.04 Crore remains for general corporate purposes and issue expenses, indicating strong adherence to stated objectives as affirmed by the Audit Committee and statutory auditors.
